title: LoopPolicy
description: One loop's complete, immutable policy: how its proposals are settled, and whether anyone is attending who could answer. A creator states any part of it as a LoopPolicyRequest and the daemon's panel supplies the rest before the loop is persisted. Workspace capability admission precedes both.

proposals.description: review holds a proposal for a client's answer; accept applies it and reject refuses it inside the loop.

attended.description: Whether an interactive partner exists who can answer. False declares an unattended loop: no human-in-the-loop surface is offered, and a wait nobody could end becomes a conclusion.

not.description: An unattended loop cannot hold a proposal for review: nobody is present to answer.
